rawFindings.title: Karma middleware can no longer be invoked by DI
rawFindings.explanation: After removing the explicit `$inject` annotation, the injector will infer the parameter name `basePath` from this function signature. The registered dependency is `config.basePath` (as the previous annotation used), not `basePath`, so `injector.invoke(karmaMiddleware.create)` in the web server fails while constructing the middleware.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore an explicit annotation, including the new injector dependency, e.g. `createKarmaMiddleware.$inject = ['filesPromise', 'serveStaticFile', 'serveFile', 'injector', 'config.basePath', 'config.urlRoot']`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Starting the web server with a normal config calls `injector.invoke(karmaMiddleware.create)` and throws a missing provider error for `basePath` instead of creating the Karma middleware.
